profile.summary: danheberden is a senior JavaScript developer with deep expertise in jQuery core development, specializing in DOM manipulation, AJAX, JSON handling, and cross-browser compatibility. Their contributions focus on performance optimization, fixing IE-specific bugs, and maintaining backward compatibility. The developer demonstrates strong debugging skills, RFC compliance (e.g., HTTP method standards), and a commitment to clean, maintainable code. While their contributions are jQuery-centric, their foundational knowledge of JavaScript language features, asynchronous operations, and browser quirks makes them highly adaptable to other JavaScript ecosystems.
skill_evidence: Fixed `.get()` and `.eq()` to avoid `slice()` for performance (PR title: '`.get()` and `.eq()` changes')
Resolved IE disabled elements firing events via `live()`/`delegate()` (Bug #6911)
Made `.ajax()` support all historical calling conventions (1.4/1.5) (Bug #8107)
Added support for explicit/relative CSS string values (e.g., `element.css('margin', '+10px')`) (Bug #7345)
Optimized `.parseJSON()` to use native `JSON.parse()` where available (Bug #7587)
Rejected a Unicode hack due to locale issues, prioritizing stability (Make fix 2)
Added test cases for delegated events in `delegatetest.html` (Bug #6911)
Noted missing upstream sync in PR #2 of Bug #8107 ('Try #2')
Referenced RFC 2616 for HTTP method casing in Bug #8113
Reformatted code to match jQuery style guidelines (PR #3: 'Reformatted inline')
